newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait share index falls another 2.44 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait share index falls another 2.44 pct in week.

text.p: Kuwait's share index dropped another 2.44 percent to 1,873 points in the week to Wednesday in trade dominated by fears of a correction.
The index, which had dropped 1.76 percent the previous week to 1,919.9 points, fell 46.9 points this week.
Some market analysts have been warning of a correction after the index hit a series of record highs in the past couple of months, rising more than 40 percent since the beginning of the year.
Economist Jassem al-Saadoun says drops in recent weeks were partial corrections which could be followed by a bigger drop.
Trading value this week was lower at 140.4 million dinars from the previous week's 287.2 million.
Volume fell to 478.4 million shares from 900 million.

Last week's largest gainer Mobile Telecommunications Co closed at 1.120 dinars this week from last Wednesday's 1.140, while Gulf Insurance Co, which posted the largest fall last week of 70 fils to 640 fils, ended this week at 630.
There are 1,000 fils to the dinar.
Only nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman and Kuwait -- can trade on the exchange. Foreign residents can invest through mutual funds.
